one_off_receipts.what: Genentech development milestone (second indication) received Q1 2024
one_off_receipts.quote: In the first quarter of 2024, following Genentech’s achievement of a development milestone in the fourth quarter of 2023 related to a second indication under the Genentech License Agreement, we received $10.0 million.

one_off_receipts.what: Genentech development milestone (third indication) received Q2 2024
one_off_receipts.quote: In the second quarter of 2024, following Genentech’s achievement of a development milestone related to a third indication under the Genentech License Agreement, we received $5.0 million.
